text_blocks.snippet: For localized prostate cancer, radical prostatectomy (surgical removal of the prostate) and radiation therapy are generally considered the most successful treatments, with similar cure rates. However, the "best" treatment depends on individual factors like the cancer's stage, grade, and the patient's overall health and preferences. For advanced prostate cancer, hormone therapy combined with other treatments like radiation or chemotherapy is often used.

list.title: Radical Prostatectomy:
list.snippet: This involves surgically removing the entire prostate gland and seminal vesicles. It can be done through open surgery, laparoscopic surgery, or robotic-assisted surgery.

list.title: Radiation Therapy:
list.snippet: This uses high-energy rays to kill cancer cells. It can be delivered externally (EBRT) or internally (brachytherapy).

list.title: Active Surveillance:
list.snippet: For low-risk prostate cancer, close monitoring with regular testing may be recommended instead of immediate treatment.

list.title: Focal Therapies:
list.snippet: These newer treatments, like cryotherapy and HIFU, aim to destroy only the tumor area, potentially minimizing side effects.

list.title: Hormone Therapy:
list.snippet: This treatment reduces the amount of testosterone in the body, which prostate cancer cells need to grow.

list.title: Chemotherapy:
list.snippet: This uses drugs to kill cancer cells, often used for advanced or hormone-resistant prostate cancer.

list.title: Other Therapies:
list.snippet: Immunotherapy, PSMA-targeted therapy, and clinical trials are also being explored for advanced cases.
Cancer Stage and Grade: The stage (how far the cancer has spread) and grade (how aggressive the cancer cells look under a microscope) are crucial in determining the best treatment.
Patient's Health: Age, overall health, and other medical conditions are important factors.
Individual Preferences: Patients should discuss the potential benefits and side effects of each treatment option with their doctor to make an informed decision.
